_meta.corpusVersionNote: Bump whenever scenarios are added, removed, or their expectations change. Aggregate scores are NOT comparable across corpus versions - a changed corpus is a changed measuring instrument, not just a changed score. The 0.7.x baselines were produced on the 60-scenario corpus (pre-2026-07-28).
_meta.purpose: Fully synthetic consolidation scenarios. No text is copied or paraphrased from production logs or user data. Expectations are defined independently of the model under test.
_meta.consumedBy: The deterministic corpus runner seeds prior cognitions, ingests messages in order, calls updateProfile(), and compares the resulting created, corrected, and conflicted cognitions with these fixed expectations.
_meta.sourceKindNote: Source kinds follow src/evidence/model.ts. These scenarios currently exercise spoken, inferred, and observed evidence; tool evidence is covered by separate adapter and ingestion tests.
_meta.gistNote: shouldFormGists lists the cognition-level claims that should form; shouldNotFormGists lists unsupported overreach. Confidence is computed by product rules rather than fixed in the corpus. Structural checks cover formedBy, confidence, and credStatus independently.
_meta.precedingAiContextNote: precedingAiContext is an optional previous assistant message used only to interpret synthetic short replies such as 'The former.' It is attached as read-only context to the user's evidence, never emitted as an independent evidence item, and is truncated to 240 characters by src/evidence/sourceLabel.ts.
_meta.formedByNote: expect.newCognitions.formedBy optionally lists allowed formation classes. Agreement with a proposition introduced by the assistant is confirmed; content stated directly by the user is stated.
